e.title: WorkbenchIQ (Microsoft)
e.summary: 核保与理赔 AI 工作台加速器（27★，MIT）：Azure Content Understanding + Foundry，文档重工作流 + Customer 360
e.body: WorkbenchIQ（JawadAminMSFT/WorkbenchIQ，27★，MIT，Python 3.10+/Node 18+，2026-04 活跃）是微软加速器：为核保人（underwriters）与理赔处理人（claims processors）提供现代 AI 工作台——结合 Azure AI Content Understanding 与 Azure AI Foundry，简化文档密集型保险工作流；内含 Customer 360 统一数据层（跨产品线聚合客户交互为单一跨角色视图）。对 RIAA：核保/理赔文档工作的现代参考实现——与 [[underwriting-workbench]]（证据优先核保工作台）、[[claims-intake-agent]]（理赔受理）互补；微软系加速器与 [[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]]、[[claims-processing-hack]] 同类；Customer 360 视角衔接客户画像分析。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：微软核保/理赔 AI 工作台加速器（Content Understanding+Foundry+Customer 360），27★，2026-04 活跃
e.summary_en: Underwriting & claims AI workbench accelerator (27★, MIT): Azure Content Understanding + Foundry, document-heavy workflows + Customer 360
e.summary_hk: 核保與理賠 AI 工作台加速器（27★，MIT）：Azure Content Understanding + Foundry，文檔重工作流 + Customer 360
e.body_en: WorkbenchIQ (JawadAminMSFT/WorkbenchIQ, 27★, MIT, Python 3.10+/Node 18+, active 2026-04) is a Microsoft accelerator: a modern AI workbench for underwriters and claims processors, combining Azure AI Content Understanding and Azure AI Foundry to streamline document-heavy insurance workflows, with a Customer 360 unified data layer that aggregates customer interactions across product lines into a single cross-persona view. For RIAA: a modern reference implementation for underwriting/claims document work — complements [[underwriting-workbench]] (evidence-first underwriting workbench) and [[claims-intake-agent]] (claims intake); in the Microsoft-accelerator family with [[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]] and [[claims-processing-hack]]; the Customer 360 angle connects to customer-profile analytics.
e.body_hk: WorkbenchIQ（JawadAminMSFT/WorkbenchIQ，27★，MIT，Python 3.10+/Node 18+，2026-04 活躍）是微軟加速器：為核保人（underwriters）與理賠處理人（claims processors）提供現代 AI 工作台——結合 Azure AI Content Understanding 與 Azure AI Foundry，簡化文檔密集型保險工作流；內含 Customer 360 統一數據層（跨產品線聚合客戶互動為單一跨角色視圖）。對 RIAA：核保/理賠文檔工作的現代參考實現——與 [[underwriting-workbench]]（證據優先核保工作台）、[[claims-intake-agent]]（理賠受理）互補；微軟系加速器與 [[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]]、[[claims-processing-hack]] 同類；Customer 360 視角銜接客戶畫像分析。
